column2: PART  IV(A) – GAZETTE EXTRAORDINARY OF THE DEMOCRATIC SOCIALIST REPUBLIC OF SRI LANKA – 05.12.2019
By-law on the Prevention of Public Disturbances in the Distribution of Free Food within Eheliyagoda
This By-law is enacted to protect the health of the public and the associated public health in the authoritative
area of the Eheliyagoda Pradeshiya Sabha.
This By-law is known as the By-law for the Prevention of Public Persecution in the Distribution of Free Food
in the Eheliyagoda Pradeshiya Sabha Authoritative Area.
If  any  person,  society  or  organization  in  the  area  of  authority  of  the  Pradeshiya  Sabha  intends  to  produce  or
distribute food for free distribution or supply or for any other special purpose for this purpose an application
under the form specified in the first schedule of this By-law should be submitted to the Eheliyagoda Pradeshiya
Sabha (Hereafter known as the PradeshiyaSabha) and obtain a license.
